zh-cn:
新增：清理已结束运行的日志记录及文件，保留运行中和已打开查看的日志。
改进：支持导出完整日志，并防止覆盖应用数据。
改进：统一使用组件库按钮，修复悬停和按下时颜色丢失。
改进：识别旧版登录启动项，改善启动设置状态和错误提示。
优化：隐藏到托盘或打开子窗口时暂停主页面刷新；保留日志搜索条件，复用已打开的日志窗口。
新增：标题栏双击最大化、弹窗 Esc 取消和复制诊断信息。
修复：具体操作结果被通用成功提示覆盖的问题。
en-us:
Added cleanup of completed run records and log files, preserving active logs and open log windows.
Added full log export with protection against overwriting application data.
Switched to built-in button styles to fix hover and pressed colors.
Improved startup status handling and detection of legacy startup entries.
Reduced background refresh, preserved log search filters, and reused existing log windows.
Added title-bar double-click maximize, Escape to cancel dialogs, and diagnostic information copying.
Fixed detailed operation results being replaced by generic success messages.
